what: Hovering a list row or thumbnail lays that row’s photo across the whole screen behind the text at 20%, and it disappears on release — instantly, no curve. Sweeping through gallery rows tints the whole screen with a different photo per row

options.--fx-bg: Photo to lay underneath — style="--fx-bg: url(…)" · If none, diagonal placeholder
options.--fx-dur: Fade in and out duration, default 0s (original has no curve, instant)

note: Because it uses a screen-fixed ::before, if an ancestor has transform, filter, perspective or contain it is laid only inside that box. The original also puts perspective only on the photo cell inside the row and not on the row itself. The document background (body) is painted, but overlapping sections must be transparent for it to show.

from.where: index.html gallery row (.ct-acc__trigger) · expanded thumbnail (.ct-thumb) — original .accordion_trigger::before · .gallery_thumb::before (opacity 0 → .2, no curve)

product.html room thumbnail grid (original .m-roomGallery .bgimg — position fixed full screen, opacity 0 → 1, .6s cubic-bezier(.55,.05,.22,.99)). At the same moment the original flips text and header to white with html.is-white and hides the thumbnail photos — that text flip is a site mechanism, so it lives in product.js
